d.title: Lupin III: Touhou Kenbunroku - Another Page
d.en: Lupin III: The Secret Page of Marco Polo
d.jp: ルパン三世 東方見聞録～アナザーページ～
syn: Lupin III: Record of Observations of the East - Another Page
d.synopsis: Lupin has become a suspect in the murder of a professor named Theo Argent. The professor had just discovered the missing page of Marco Polo's Record of Observations of the East travel journal. As Lupin is being pursued by the police, he ends up getting unlikely help from the granddaughter of Theo Argent, Lisa.
